page.title: Smart allocation
page.description: The engine proposes room assignments to improve occupancy and revenue. Review each move before applying it.
page.actionFailed: The operation could not be completed: {{message}}
page.genericFailure: The operation could not be completed.
page.staleProposal: Reservations changed after this calculation. The proposal was not applied. Reject it and generate a new proposal to review the current state.

policy.title: Allocation objective
policy.description: Choose what the engine should prioritize. The policy applies to future proposals.
policy.revenueWeightHelp: The remaining weight goes to occupied nights.
policy.combinedNote: This percentage sets the net revenue weight; the remainder goes to occupancy. The engine needs comparable values across reservations. If currencies differ without a current saved FX quote, it will stop and explain why.
policy.revenueCurrencyNote: Net revenue is compared when reservations use a comparable currency. If the data cannot be compared, the engine stops and explains the issue.
policy.saved: The new policy version is active.

proposal.title: Latest proposal
proposal.description: Review the current room, suggested room, and reason. Accept applies the changes explicitly; reject keeps current assignments.
proposal.recalculateHelp: Calculation does not change rooms. It creates a proposal for review first.
proposal.resolveBeforeRecalculate: Accept or reject the pending proposal before generating another.
proposal.empty: There are no proposals yet. Generate one to evaluate current availability.
proposal.noAssignments: This calculation did not produce room assignments.

reasons.optimizesRoomUse: Rearranges rooms to make better use of inventory
reasons.returningGuest: Keeps a room used during a previous stay
reasons.noDetails: The engine did not provide an additional reason

proposal.acceptRequiresSuccess: This calculation did not complete successfully. You can reject its proposal, but cannot apply it.
proposal.confirmAccept: Confirming will move the {{count}} proposed reservations. Continue?
proposal.confirmReject: Confirming will discard the {{count}} suggestions and keep current rooms. Continue?
proposal.reviewed: There are no pending moves in this proposal.

solverErrors.mixedCurrency: The engine could not compare net revenue because it found different currencies without a current saved FX quote. Update the comparison basis or temporarily choose occupied nights; no changes were applied.
solverErrors.combinedUnavailable: The engine could not compare occupancy and net revenue with the current data. Review the scale and saved quotes; no changes were applied.

locks.title: Protected reservations
locks.description: Pin a room when it must remain with a reservation. The engine will exclude it from future automatic reassignment.
locks.readPermissionRequired: Your role cannot view reservations. You can review proposals, but cannot manage protected reservations.
locks.empty: There are no upcoming reservations to show.
locks.lockNotAvailable: Only an assigned reservation before check-in can be protected.
